name: Claude (web, Desktop and mobile)
steps: On claude.ai, open Settings > Connectors and add a custom connector named FreeGameStore with the server URL.
Sign in and review the permissions. Use the connected account in Desktop or mobile where remote connectors are supported.
Start a conversation, enable FreeGameStore and ask for the platform guide.

name: ChatGPT
steps: Open Plugins > Add custom MCP server (older interfaces: Apps / Connectors > Advanced > Developer mode). Workspace permission may be required.
Enter the server URL, choose OAuth and connect your FreeGameStore account.
Enable FreeGameStore in a conversation and ask for the platform guide before approving writes.

name: Gemini CLI / Antigravity
steps: In Gemini CLI, run the command below. Gemini web does not accept this CLI configuration.
In Antigravity, open the MCP server settings, add a custom remote server using the server URL, then reload the tools.
Complete sign-in when prompted and request the platform guide. Availability and OAuth support depend on your client version.
snippet: gemini mcp add --transport http freegamestore https://mcp.freegamestore.online/mcp

name: Grok
steps: On a paid plan with custom connectors enabled, open connector settings and add a custom remote MCP connector. Workspace administrators may control access.
Enter the server URL and complete OAuth sign-in.
Enable the connector in a conversation and ask for the platform guide. This is a custom connection; catalog availability is separate.

name: Claude Code
steps: Run the command below in your terminal.
Open /mcp in Claude Code and authenticate FreeGameStore.
Ask for the platform guide, then review tool permissions before building.
snippet: claude mcp add --transport http freegamestore https://mcp.freegamestore.online/mcp

name: Cursor
steps: Add the configuration below to .cursor/mcp.json (project) or ~/.cursor/mcp.json (personal).
Reload MCP tools, connect FreeGameStore and complete OAuth sign-in.
Ask Agent for the platform guide.

name: Windsurf
steps: Open Cascade MCP settings and edit mcp_config.json.
Add the configuration below, reload and complete sign-in when prompted.
Enable FreeGameStore tools and ask Cascade for the platform guide.

name: VS Code
steps: Run MCP: Add Server from the Command Palette and choose HTTP.
Enter the server URL and name freegamestore, or add the configuration below to .vscode/mcp.json.
Start the server, complete sign-in and enable its tools in Copilot agent chat.
